note: Persistent architectural memory: constraints, cross-service contracts, and assumptions retrievable via `ai-project decisions`.

constraints.title: Frontend must never call ai-service directly
constraints.detail: All AI endpoints are proxied by the Express backend under /api/v1/ai/*; ai-service is unauthenticated on the private network.

constraints.title: AI failures must not block complaint registration
constraints.detail: MockAiService falls back to local keyword rules when the remote AI service is unreachable.

constraints.title: Volunteer is the primary registration path
constraints.detail: Citizens may self-register, but the volunteer flow verifies citizen identity on behalf of rural users.

constraints.title: Role-based authorization enforced per route
constraints.detail: Express routes use authorize(<Role>) middleware; roles: Citizen, Volunteer, Department Admin, Super Admin.

constraints.title: MongoDB accessed only via repositories
constraints.detail: Controllers/Services never query Mongoose models directly; persistence goes through the repository layer.

api_contracts.frontend_to_backend: REST /api/v1/*, JWT bearer token (axios interceptor), envelope {success, message, data}
api_contracts.backend_to_ai: REST /api/ai/* (settings.api_prefix), no auth, ApiResponse{success, message, data} pydantic envelope

security_assumptions: JWT access+refresh tokens issued by backend only
ai-service reachable only on the internal docker network
uploads validated by multer + ai-service file_validation.py
deployment_assumptions: Each subsystem has its own Dockerfile and docker-compose
MongoDB provisioned externally to the backend container
AI_SERVICE_URL env var required by backend config (env.ts)
